name: Claude Opus 5.5
note_long: The most consistent model in the test. Every medium run has the full e-foil: one mast, a motor pod with a propeller, an underwater wing, and a throttle remote in the penguin's flipper. The four drawings look almost interchangeable.

note.en: Full e-foil in every run: mast, motor, propeller, wing, remote.
note.ru: Полный e-foil в каждом прогоне: мачта, мотор, винт, крыло, пульт.
